trigger: All six initial frozen native-probe validation grids favoured the largest C=10. Initial test results had already been generated and were known. The expansion is exploratory, motivated by validation boundary selection, not prospectively registered with the initial study.
scope: ConvNeXt native balanced and all-training probes on both datasets; DINOv2 all-training probes on both datasets
criterion: validation accuracy only; first grid entry breaks ties; optimiser must converge
held_fixed: Features, labels, splits, preprocessing, native feature normalization and sampling. Original and extension 64-D head configurations remain unchanged.
record_policy: Preserve initial locks and copy initial prediction/model records to a local diagnostic archive. Use separate final expanded-grid locks for reported native probes. Export predictions from final selected models only; do not choose by test metrics.
